title: Pooled CRISPR-activation screening coupled with single-cell RNA-seq in mouse embryonic stem cells
protocol: Seed 3.5 million HEK293T cells per transfection in 100 mm tissue culture plates with 10 mL of pre-warmed D10 media, 16–20 h before transfection.
Obtain three sterile 1.5 mL tubes and label them 1, 2, and 3.
Add 1.5 mL of opti-MEM to each tube.
To Tube 1, add 3.5 μg of pMD2.G, 6.5 μg of psPAX2, and 10 μg of lenti dCas9-VP64_Blast plasmid.
To Tube 2, add 3.5 μg of pMD2.G, 6.5 μg of psPAX2, and 10 μg of lenti MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro plasmid.
To Tube 3, add 3.5 μg of pMD2.G, 6.5 μg of psPAX2, and 10 μg of custom sgRNA library cloned into CROP-sgRNA-MS2 plasmid.
Vortex each tube briefly.
Add 60 μL of transIT-293 transfection reagent to each tube.
Vortex each tube briefly again.
Incubate the tubes at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Aspirate D10 media from three plates of HEK293T cells.
Add 8.5 mL of pre-warmed mESC media without LIF to each plate.
Prepare the mESC media with DMEM, 15% fetal bovine serum, 1 U/mL penicillin, 1 mg/mL streptomycin, 0.1 mM nonessential amino acids, 2 mM GlutaMAX, and 50 μM β-mercaptoethanol.
Add each transfection mix drop-wise to one of the prepared plates of HEK293T cells.
Return plates to incubator for culture at 37°C in 5% CO₂ for 48 hours.
Collect 10 mL of lentiviral supernatant from each plate using a 20 mL syringe.
Filter the collected supernatant into a 15 mL tube through a 0.45 μm PES filter.
Prepare aliquots of 1 mL of the clarified supernatant for dCas9-VP64_Blast and MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro.
Use only cellulose acetate or polyethersulfone filters; avoid nitrocellulose filters.
Combine 1 volume of Lenti-X Concentrator with 3 volumes of lentiviral supernatant.
Mix by inversion.
Incubate the mix at 4°C for 4 h to 16 h.
Centrifuge the mix at 1,500 × g for 45 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet with fresh serum/LIF media to 1/10 to 1/20 of the original volume of clarified lentiviral supernatant.
Prepare 100 μL aliquots of the concentrated lentivirus and store at −70°C.
Titer dCas9-VP64_Blast and MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro lentiviral preparations in mESCs.
Count 1.56 million cells for seeding in 12 gelatinized wells of a 24-well plate.
Spin down cell suspension at 300 × g for 3 min at room temperature and resuspend in serum/LIF culture media.
Add polybrene to the cell suspension to a final concentration of 16 μg/mL.
Seed cells in 12 gelatinized wells with cell suspension + polybrene.
Thaw dCas9-VP64_Blast and MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro lentiviral preparations on ice if stored at -70°C.
Add 103 U/mL LIF to each lentiviral preparation.
Pipette 400 μL of dCas9-VP64_Blast lentivirus into Well 1.
Mix 200 μL of dCas9-VP64_Blast lentivirus with 200 μL of serum/LIF media in Well 2.
Combine 100 μL of dCas9-VP64_Blast lentivirus with 300 μL of serum/LIF media in Well 3.
Mix 50 μL of dCas9-VP64_Blast lentivirus with 350 μL of serum/LIF media in Well 4.
Combine 25 μL of dCas9-VP64_Blast lentivirus with 375 μL of serum/LIF media in Well 5.
Add 400 μL of serum/LIF media to Well 6 as a non-transduced control well.
Pipette 400 μL of MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro lentivirus into Well 1.
Mix 200 μL of MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro lentivirus with 200 μL of serum/LIF media in Well 2.
Combine 100 μL of MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro lentivirus with 300 μL of serum/LIF media in Well 3.
Mix 50 μL of MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro lentivirus with 350 μL of serum/LIF media in Well 4.
Combine 25 μL of MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro lentivirus with 375 μL of serum/LIF media in Well 5.
Add 400 μL of serum/LIF media to Well 6 as a non-transduced control well.
Mix each well thoroughly by pipetting up and down.
Return the plate to the incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Remove media from each well after 24 hours.
Wash each well twice with PBS.
Add 800 μL of fresh serum/LIF culture media to each well.
Trypsinize and split each well of cells into two gelatinized wells of a 24-well plate approximately 24 hours after transduction.
Culture one well in serum/LIF media with 20 μg/mL blasticidin for dCas9-VP64_Blast transduced cells.
Culture another well in serum/LIF media without antibiotics for non-transduced + blasticidin control cells.
Culture one well of MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro transduced cells in serum/LIF media with 200 μg/mL hygromycin.
Culture another well of non-transduced cells in serum/LIF media with 200 μg/mL hygromycin as a control.
Expand cells from individual wells when they reach 80% confluency for the next 6-7 days.
Transfer all cells to a gelatinized 6-well plate during the first passage without discarding any cells.
Subsequently transfer cells to gelatinized 100 mm plates in later passages.
Trypsinize cells for viral titer calculation.
Count and record the total number of cells in each well/plate.
Calculate MOI as the number of cells in the transduced + antibiotic condition divided by the number of cells in the transduced no-antibiotic condition.
Transduce dCas9-VP64_Blast and MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro lentiviruses into mESCs at a MOI of 0.5–0.7.
Calculate the volume of dCas9-VP64_Blast lentivirus needed for 2.5 million cells based on titration experiment results.
Calculate the volume of MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro lentivirus needed for 2.5 million cells based on titration experiment results.
Thaw aliquots of dCas9-VP64_Blast lentivirus and MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro lentivirus on ice.
Combine the calculated volumes of dCas9-VP64_Blast and MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro lentiviruses.
Add 103 U/mL LIF to the combined lentiviral mix.
Top up the total volume to 15 mL with serum/LIF culture media if necessary.
Add 8 μg/mL polybrene to the 15 mL of combined lentivirus.
Mix gently by pipetting.
Trypsinize a confluent plate of low-passage mESC (<10 passages) and count the cell suspension.
Transfer 2.5 million cells to a new tube and spin down at 300 × g for 3 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in ∼15 mL of mix containing the combined lentiviral preparation + LIF + polybrene.
Seed cells + lentiviral mix in a 100 mm gelatinized tissue culture plate and return to incubator (37°C in 5% CO2).
Seed an additional 2.5 million mESCs in another 100 mm gelatinized tissue culture plate for non-transduced + antibiotic selection control.
Add 8 μg/mL polybrene to the seeded cells, mix gently and return to incubator (37°C in 5% CO2).
After 24 h, remove media from both plates.
Wash twice with PBS.
Add 10 mL of fresh serum/LIF culture media per plate.
Replace media with serum/LIF media containing 20 μg/mL blasticidin and 200 μg/mL hygromycin for plates transduced with dCas9-VP64_Blast/MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro.
Grow cells in selection media for 10–14 days until individual colonies are observed in the plate of transduced cells.
Remove media from plate of transduced and selected cells.
Wash once with PBS.
Add 10 mL of PBS to the plates and inspect under a microscope with 4× magnification.
Circle the desired colony with a 20 μL pipette tip and set volume to 15 μL.
Scrape the colony to dislodge it and then aspirate.
Select colonies that are spaced well enough apart to avoid contamination from surrounding colonies.
Select rounded or oval colonies, with a phase contrast bright edge and often a dark necrotic center.
Do not pick differentiated colonies that appear flat and surrounded by fibroblast-like cells.
Transfer the picked colony to a single well of a 96-well U-shaped-bottom plate containing 25 μl of trypsin-EDTA.
Pipette up and down to help dissociate the colony.
Repeat steps for picking additional colonies as needed (5–10 colonies or maximum number that can be picked in approximately 5 minutes).
Add 175 μl of serum/LIF culture media to colonies in 96-well plate.
Do not leave colonies in trypsin-EDTA for longer than 5 minutes before neutralizing with serum/LIF media.
Check the dissociation of colonies under a microscope if necessary and add serum/LIF media only after complete dissociation.
Repeat steps until 20–30 colonies have been picked.
Transfer each dissociated colony from the 96-well plate to a well in a gelatinized 24-well plate.
Add 600 μl of serum/LIF media to each well.
Return plate to incubator for culturing at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Trypsinize clones when they reach 70%–80% confluency.
Transfer trypsinized clones to a gelatinized 6-well plate with 2 mL of serum/LIF media.
Divide each well containing a clone into three 2 mL tubes at a ratio of 1:1:1.
Spin down one tube from each clone at 300 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and immediately snap freeze the pellet in dry ice or liquid nitrogen for genomic DNA/RNA extraction.
Follow the same steps for non-transduced mESCs as a negative control for downstream analysis of genomic DNA and RNA.
Use another tube from each clone for cryopreservation, following step 5 of the "before you begin" section.
Seed cells from the last tube in an individual gelatinized well from a 6-well plate in serum/LIF culture media for routine mESC maintenance.
Store cell pellets from genomic DNA/RNA extraction at −70°C long-term or proceed immediately to further analysis steps.
Cryopreserved clonal lines can be stored long-term in liquid nitrogen.
Extract genomic DNA and RNA for each clone and for non-transduced mESCs.
Use the AllPrep DNA/RNA Mini Kit (Qiagen, 80204) following manufacturer’s instructions.
Measure DNA and RNA concentration using a nanodrop or similar device.
Store RNA long-term at −70°C.
Store DNA purifications at −20°C or proceed immediately to step 12.
Perform PCR on genomic DNA from each clone to identify dCas9-VP64_Blast and MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro integrations.
Set up 2 PCR reactions for each clone, including negative and positive controls.
Run the first PCR reaction to test for integration of dCas9-VP64_Blast.
Run the second PCR reaction to test for integration of MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro.
Run PCRs according to the specified conditions.
Analyze PCR products using an agarose gel.
Expect a band size of 275 bp for dCas9-VP64_Blast expression and 672 bp for MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro expression.
Verify dCas9-VP64 and MS2-p65-HSF1 mRNA expression by q-RT-PCR in clones containing both dCas9-VP64_Blast and MS2-p65-HSF1_Hygro genomic integrations.
Include non-transduced mESCs as a negative control.
Treat 2 μg of RNA from each sample with DNaseI to remove contaminating genomic DNA.
Perform cDNA synthesis from 0.5 μg DNaseI-treated total RNA from each sample using RevertAid First-Strand cDNA synthesis kit.
Dilute the cDNA from each sample by adding 180 μl of nuclease-free water to the 20 μl of cDNA obtained, to a total volume of 200 μl.
Perform q-RT-PCR using Brilliant III SYBR master mix.
Set up four reactions for each cDNA with specific primers in technical triplicates.
Quantify relative levels of dCas9-VP64 and MS2-p65-HSF1 using the comparative CT method.
Normalize expression levels to average Gapdh and CycloB1 levels.
Identify clones with a fold change of >1000 in relative expression compared to non-transduced mESCs.
Perform RNA-seq on selected positive clones for genomic DNA integrations and mRNA expression of dCas9-VP64 and MS2-p65-HSF1, as well as non-transduced mESCs as a control.
Construct RNA-seq libraries using the TruSeq Stranded Total RNA Library Prep Human/Mouse/Rat Kit (Illumina, 20020596).
Start with 1 μg of DNaseI-treated RNA.
Follow manufacturer’s instructions for library preparation.
Sequence at a coverage of 10–20 million reads per sample.
Generate 50 bp single-end reads during sequencing.
Verify dCas9-VP64 and MS2-p65-HSF1 expression in the positive clones.
Compare expression to non-transduced mESCs.
Perform differential gene expression analysis using DESeq2.
Use EdgeR for each clone, normalized to non-transduced mESCs.
Select a clone with none or few differentially expressed genes compared to non-transduced mESCs.
Design individual sgRNAs into the lentiviral backbone CROP-sgRNA-MS2.
Generate sgRNA lentiviruses following the protocol steps 1–5.
Titer sgRNA lentiviruses in a clone of SAM mESCs using steps 15–27 of the protocol.
Transduce and select sgRNA lentiviruses targeting genes of interest as well as non-targeting controls at a MOI <0.3 into different SAM mESC clones following steps 28–33 of the protocol.
Harvest RNA 7-10 days after sgRNA transduction, using steps 10b and 11 of the protocol.
Perform q-RT-PCR with custom primers and/or RNA-seq to compare levels of target gene activation across different SAM mESC clones, normalized to respective non-targeting sgRNA samples.
Thaw the selected clone of SAM mESCs if required.
Passage the selected SAM mESC clone at least twice in serum/LIF media containing 20 μg/mL blasticidin and 200 μg/mL hygromycin for 5 days.
Count a confluent plate of SAM mESCs to obtain 1.08 million cells.
Spin down the cell suspension at 300 × g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cell pellet in 7.02 mL of serum/LIF culture media.
Add polybrene to the cell suspension to a final concentration of 8.2 μl/mL.
Transfer 780 μl of cell suspension + polybrene to each of 8 gelatinized wells in a 24-well plate.
Thaw 1 aliquot of the lentiviral custom sgRNA library on ice.
Add 20 μl of lentivirus to Well 1.
Mix 10 μl of lentivirus and 10 μl of serum/LIF media, then add to Well 2.
Combine 5 μl of lentivirus with 15 μl of serum/LIF media, then add to Well 3.
Add a mixture of 2.5 μl lentivirus and 17.5 μl serum/LIF media to Well 4.
Mix 1.25 μl of lentivirus with 18.75 μl of serum/LIF media and transfer to Well 5.
Combine 0.625 μl of lentivirus with 19.375 μl of serum/LIF media, then add to Well 6.
Add 20 μl of serum/LIF media to Well 7 as a non-transduced +antibiotic control.
Transfer 20 μl of serum/LIF media to Well 8 as a non-transduced no-antibiotic control.
Mix each well thoroughly by pipetting up and down.
Return the plate to the incubator at 37°C in 5% CO₂ for 24 hours.
Remove the media from each well after 24 hours.
Wash each well twice with PBS.
Add 800 μl of fresh serum/LIF culture media to each well.
Trypsinize and expand cells from each individual well to a gelatinized well from a 6-well plate with 2 mL of serum/LIF media per well, approximately 24 hours after transduction.
Approximately 24 hours later (approximately 72 hours after transduction), prepare cells for mCherry flow cytometry analysis: Prepare ice-cold PBS containing 0.1% FBS.
Trypsinize cells.
Re-plate half of the cells per condition in a gelatinized well of a 6-well plate.
Count approximately 0.5 million cells per condition and spin them down at 300 × g for 3 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Resuspend pellet in 500 μl ice-cold PBS containing 0.1% FBS.
Pass cells through a 40 μm cell strainer into a 5 mL round bottom tube for flow cytometry analysis.
Add 1 μg/mL of DAPI and incubate for 15 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Perform flow cytometry analysis gating on live cells expressing the lentiviral custom sgRNA library (DAPI-/mCherry+).
Replace media with serum/LIF media containing 1 μg/mL puromycin in wells with transduced cells and the non-transduced +antibiotic control condition.
Do not add puromycin to the non-transduced no-antibiotic control well.
Repeat flow cytometry analysis following steps 24–25 after 3–4 days of puromycin addition.
Verify that all transduced conditions have 95%–100% mCherry+ cells.
Thaw SAM mESCs if required.
Passage SAM mESCs at least twice.
Culture SAM mESCs in serum/LIF media containing 20 μg/mL blasticidin and 200 μg/mL hygromycin for 5 days prior to screening.
Calculate the number of cells needed for transduction to maintain a representation of 1000 cells per sgRNA at a MOI<0.3.
For example, prepare a total of 5 million cells if aiming for 500,000 cells remaining after antibiotic selection and flow cytometry analyses.
Transduce the lentiviral custom sgRNA library into SAM mESCs at a MOI < 0.3.
Calculate the volume of lentivirus required based on previous calculations.
Thaw the required number of aliquots of the lentiviral preparation on ice.
Trypsinize a confluent plate of SAM mESCs and count the cells.
Spin down cell suspension at 300 × g for 3 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 1 mL of serum/LIF media.
To the resuspended cell pellet, add the calculated volume of lentivirus.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down.
Top up with serum/LIF media to the appropriate final volume for tissue culture plates.
Add 8 μg/mL polybrene (Millpore, TR-1003-G) and mix gently by pipetting.
Seed cells resuspended in the lentiviral mix + polybrene in the appropriate gelatinized cell culture plate.
Return plate to incubator (37°C in 5% CO2).
Plate two additional 100 mm plates with 2.5 million SAM mESCs for non-transduced + antibiotic selection control and non-transduced no-antibiotic control.
Add 8 μg/mL polybrene (Millpore, TR-1003-G) to the additional plates and mix gently.
Remove media from cells after 24 hours of transduction.
Wash cells twice with PBS.
Add fresh serum/LIF culture media.
Verify low MOI after 48 hours (72 hours post-transduction).
Prepare ice-cold PBS containing 0.1% FBS for flow cytometry analysis.
Trypsinize cells.
Count 0.2–0.5 million cells to be used for flow cytometry analysis and re-plate the rest of the cells in an appropriate gelatinized cell culture plate in serum/LIF media.
Spin down cells at 300 × g for 3 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Resuspend pellet in 200–500 μl ice-cold PBS containing 0.1% FBS.
Pass resuspended cells through a 40 μm cell strainer into a 5 mL round bottom tube for flow cytometry analysis.
Add 1 μg/mL of DAPI to the filtered cell suspension and incubate for 15 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Perform flow cytometry analysis gating on live cells expressing the lentiviral custom sgRNA library (DAPI-/mCherry+).
Set the mCherry+ gate using the non-transduced control.
Verify MOI < 0.3 based on the percentage of mCherry+ cells.
Replace media with serum/LIF media containing 1 μg/mL puromycin for transduced cells and non-transduced + antibiotic control condition after verifying cells were transduced at a MOI < 0.3.
Do not add puromycin to the non-transduced no-antibiotic control condition.
Repeat flow cytometry analysis following step 31 to verify selection of transduced cells for expression of the custom sgRNA library.
Harvest and prepare cells for 10× Genomics scRNA-seq using ice-cold PBS containing 0.1% FBS.
Cool down a centrifuge with 15 and/or 50 mL tube buckets to 4°C.
Ensure a clean and highly viable single-cell suspension for optimal formation of single-cell droplets or GEMs.
Remove media from cells and wash twice with room temperature PBS.
Trypsinize cells very briefly for 2-3 minutes.
Add serum/LIF media to the plate: use 1 mL of trypsin and 3 mL of serum/LIF media for a 100 mm plate, or 3 mL of trypsin and 9 mL of serum/LIF media for a 150 mm plate.
Gently mix cells by pipetting up and down to obtain a single-cell suspension.
Check cells are properly detached and dissociated under a microscope.
Further inactivate trypsin with extra serum/LIF media: use 6 mL for a 100 mm plate or 13 mL for a 150 mm plate, resulting in a final volume of 10 mL or 25 mL respectively.
Spin down cell suspension at 300 × g for 3 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend cell pellet in 1 mL of ice-cold PBS containing 0.1% FBS.
Pass cell suspension through a 40 μm cell strainer into a new tube.
Count cell suspension using a viability dye, making appropriate dilutions if needed.
Count cells using an automated cell counter with viability read-out.
Count three different aliquots of each cell suspension/dilution, with two counts for each aliquot.
Do not proceed with cell suspensions that show <90% viability.

Dilute counted cell suspension in PBS containing 0.1% FBS or concentrate cells by centrifugation (300 × g for 3 min at 4°C) to obtain a cell suspension of 700–1200 cells/mL, in ice-cold PBS containing 0.1% FBS.
Keep cells on ice immediately after dilution/concentration.
Proceed fast during sample counting and dilution not to exceed 1.5 hours from cell trypsinization to loading in the 10× Genomics Chromium Controller.
Use 10× Genomics Chromium single cell 3′ v3.1 kits to build scRNA-seq libraries.
Run the single-cell suspension on the 10× Genomics Chromium Controller using the 3′ v3.1 kit protocol.
Follow manufacturer’s instructions for the procedure.
Set aside 10 ng of full-length cDNA for each 10× Genomics sample/lane.
Construct sgRNA amplicon libraries using the set-aside 10 ng cDNA samples.
Build 3′ gene expression libraries with 10 μL of full-length cDNA.
Perform three rounds of semi-nested PCR amplification to construct sgRNA amplicon libraries.
Monitor PCR reactions using KAPA SYBR.
Run PCR in a q-RT-PCR-compatible instrument with the specified conditions.
Purify the resulting reactions using 1× AMPure XP beads.
Obtain AMPure XP beads from 4°C storage and warm to room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 30 min.
If required, recover the PCR products from the q-RT-PCR plate into PCR tube strips or into a 96-well plate.
Add 10 μl of nuclease-free water to each PCR product and vortex to resuspend the AMPure XP beads.
Add 20 μl AMPure XP beads (1×) to each sample and mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate samples for 15 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Place PCR tube strip or 96-well plate on an appropriate magnetic stand until the solution clears.
Remove and discard supernatant(s).
Add 100 μl of 80% ethanol to each pellet. Wait 30 s. Remove the ethanol.
Repeat ethanol wash for a total of 2 washes.
Centrifuge PCR tube strip or 96-well plate briefly and place back on appropriate magnetic stand.
Remove any remaining ethanol from each sample.
Air dry for 1–2 min.
Add 21 μl of nuclease-free water to each sample and mix by pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate samples for 10 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Place the PCR tube strip or 96-well plate on the magnet until the solution clears.
For each sample, transfer 20 μl of the supernatant containing the purified PCR product to a new PCR tube strip or well of 96-well.
Dilute each purified PCR1 product 1:25 by adding 1 μl of sample to 24 μl of nuclease-free water.
Store the remaining PCR1 sample long-term at -20°C.
Prepare a master-mix for PCR2 on ice using specified reagents and volumes.
Add 1 μl of the 1:25 dilution of purified PCR1 product as input to each PCR reaction in a 96-well or 384-well plate.
Run PCR reactions in a q-RT-PCR-compatible instrument according to specified conditions.
Purify resulting reactions using 1× AMPure XP beads, following specific step guidelines.
Dilute each purified PCR2 product 1:25 by adding 1 μl of sample to 24 μl of nuclease-free water.
Store the remaining PCR2 sample long-term at -20°C.
Prepare a master-mix for PCR3 on ice using specified reagents and volumes.
Dilute purified PCR2 product at a ratio of 1:25.
Add 1 μl of the diluted PCR2 product to each sample's PCR reaction in a 96-well or 384-well plate.
Use Nextera XT P7 index primer with sequence CAAGCAGAAGACGGCATACGAGAT-[8 bp Index]-GTCTCGTGGGCTCGG for forward priming.
Use reverse primer AATGATACGGCGACCACCGAGATCTACACTCTTTCCCTACACGACGCTC from PCR2.
Pool sgRNA amplicon libraries from different samples following Illumina’s index adapters pooling guide.
Ensure appropriate index sets are used if sequencing together with 3′ scRNA-seq gene expression libraries to avoid index overlap in the multiplexed pool.
Run PCR in a q-RT-PCR-compatible instrument using the specified conditions.
Purify the resulting reactions using 1× AMPure XP beads, following step 49c.
Dilute each of the resulting sgRNA amplicon libraries at a ratio of 1:10.
Run 1 μL of each diluted sgRNA amplicon library on an Agilent Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity chip, following manufacturer’s instructions.
